name: certpath
description: CertPath monorepo scripts: run the API, learner app and backoffice together

scripts.setup: npm --prefix api ci && npm --prefix admin ci && npm --prefix mobile ci
scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,admin,mobile --prefix-colors magenta,cyan,green --kill-others-on-fail "npm --prefix api run dev" "npm --prefix admin run dev" "npm --prefix mobile run web"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix api run typecheck && npm --prefix admin run typecheck && cd mobile && npx tsc --noEmit
